scope: SaiAdmin 6.1.5 runtime export data exclusion in the Linux amd64 musl distribution
cause: plugin/saiadmin/public/export was treated as a static resource, copying nine pre-existing private spreadsheet exports into both earlier test distributions

fix.behavior: Exclude runtime export and storage contents from source snapshot, mirror and resource package; retain an empty writable export directory; reject PHP and symlinks inside excluded directories

fixedInstallerArchives.archiveIntegrity: both pass after copying into the project distribution directory

windowsInstalledCli.redundantFullRebuild: not required or counted as a delivery gate: the previously compared Mac and Windows ELF hashes match the repaired Mac ELF; the repair only changes runtime resource copying
windowsInstalledCli.isolatedTestDirectoryCleanup: pass: D:/aot-installer-verify-20260925 removed and Test-Path returned false; original D:/htdocs projects untouched

priorMacWindowsSaiAdminBuild.note: Both prior packages had the runtime export leak and are not distribution candidates.

targetHostsForSameElf: CentOS 7.9 x86_64 VM: static ELF, startup and captcha pass
Alibaba Cloud Linux 3 x86_64 ECS: static ELF, startup and captcha pass

limits: No claim is made that the repaired Windows installer independently produced a second post-fix distribution; its installed code hash and doctor were checked.
Target hosts did not run login, authenticated user information or permission-denial paths against an isolated database.
The candidate is uncommitted and unpublished; license review remains open.
